capabilities: Repair Mermaid syntax errors in the active note
Scan the whole vault for Mermaid and table issues
Preview proposed edits as a diff before applying
Conservatively repair broken Markdown table structures
Toggle each fix rule independently in settings
disambiguation: Despite the name, it also repairs broken Markdown tables, not only Mermaid diagrams.
extras: Free and local-only: no accounts, API keys, network requests, or telemetry. Documents that it reads vault files only during the whole-vault command, with full data-flow details in PRIVACY.md.
motivation: The author built it because AIGC tools frequently produce Mermaid blocks and tables that look almost right while failing to render in Obsidian.
problem: AI-generated or hand-edited Mermaid diagrams and tables often look almost valid but fail to render in Obsidian, and fixing them by hand is repetitive.

relations.evidence: Try Mermaid ELK Renderer - Obsidian Plugin with bundled Mermaid 11 enabled.

summary: Rule-based repairer that fixes broken Mermaid diagram syntax and Markdown tables in the current note or across the whole vault.
